<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="סיון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918762_theRebbe_940" batchId="meluket-_D7_A1_D7_99_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918762_theRebbe_940__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the four letters of the Name Havayah in every Jew's soul and body, focusing on the body's physical form as a diagram of the Name and the role of the milui (filling) in revealing the inner essence of Havayah within the physical body.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And the matter of the Name Havayah that is in every Jew,</t>
    <t s="2">is explained in the maamar,</t>
    <t s="3">that the yud of the Name Havayah in Israel is the wisdom (chochmah) in the soul,</t>
    <t s="4">and the hei of the Name Havayah is the understanding (binah) in the soul,</t>
    <t s="5">to understand one thing from another.</t>
    <t s="6">And "one thing from another" (davar mitoch davar) refers to the word of Havayah that is clothed within the creations,</t>
    <t s="7">according to the interpretation of the Baal Shem Tov</t>
    <t s="8">on the verse,</t>
    <t s="9">"Forever, Havayah, Your word stands firm in the heavens,"</t>
    <t s="10">and "word" (davar) is the speech itself that is above the clothing within creations,</t>
    <t s="11">which in general is the encompassing light (Or HaSovev),</t>
    <t s="12">and this is [the meaning of] "to understand one thing from another,"</t>
    <t s="13">that through contemplation upon the word of Havayah that is clothed within the creations</t>
    <t s="14">("one thing" — davar)</t>
    <t s="15">which is only an illumination</t>
    <t s="16">(as is proven from this very fact that it is clothed within the creations)</t>
    <t s="17">one comes to the knowledge that there is a "word" (davar) that is above clothing within the world,</t>
    <t s="18">which is the source from which the illumination within the clothing is drawn.</t>
    <t s="19">And the vav of the Name Havayah is the emotions (middos) in the soul,</t>
    <t s="20">and the final hei of the Name Havayah is the lower awe (yirah tata'ah)</t>
    <t s="21">(acceptance of the yoke)</t>
    <t s="22">in the soul.</t>
    <t s="23">And the maamar continues,</t>
    <t s="24">that the four letters of the Name Havayah that are in every Jew are also in his body.</t>
    <t s="25">For the head is like the form of the image of the yud, and the body is like the form of the image of the vav, and the five fingers of the hand and the five toes of the foot are the two hei's.</t>
    <t s="26">And the maamar adds,</t>
    <t s="27">that it can be said,</t>
    <t s="28">that the reason there are ten fingers on the hands and ten toes on the feet is,</t>
    <t s="29">because in the Name Havayah with the filling of hei's (milui d'hein),</t>
    <t s="30">in each hei there are two hei's.</t>
    <t s="31">And it can be said that through the addition that the number ten fingers corresponds to the hei in its filling, additional explanation is added in the entire matter of the diagram of the Name Havayah in the body.</t>
    <t s="32">For it is known regarding the matter of the fillings (miluyim),</t>
    <t s="33">that the reason for this is that the filling of the letter is in concealment</t>
    <t s="34">[And as in the letter alef,</t>
    <t s="35">that the alef itself is revealed,</t>
    <t s="36">and the lamed and the pei</t>
    <t s="37">(which are its filling)</t>
    <t s="38">are included within it in concealment],</t>
    <t s="39">it is,</t>
    <t s="40">because the filling is its inwardness and essentiality that is above revelation.</t>
    <t s="41">And analogous to a person who speaks about some matter and has an intention in it,</t>
    <t s="42">that the intention is in concealment.</t>
    <t s="43">And from this it is understood,</t>
    <t s="44">that this [fact] that in the diagram of the Name Havayah in the body</t>
    <t s="45">(specifically)</t>
    <t s="46">there is also the filling of the hei's of the Name Havayah,</t>
    <t s="47">it is,</t>
    <t s="48">because specifically in the body is revealed</t>
    <t s="49">(also)</t>
    <t s="50">the inwardness and essentiality of the Name Havayah.</t>
    <t s="51">For in order for there to be a drawing down of the Name Havayah into the physical body,</t>
    <t s="52">it is specifically through the inwardness and essentiality of the Name Havayah.</t>
    <t s="53">And analogous to what was explained above</t>
    <t s="54">(section 3),</t>
    <t s="55">that in order for the Name Havayah that is in the soul to be revealed also in its clothing within the body, it is through the drawing down of "Anochi" that is above Havayah.</t>
    <t s="56">And the distinction between these two matters is,</t>
    <t s="57">that the innovation in the revelation of the Name Havayah in the soul also in its clothing within the body is only regarding the place</t>
    <t s="58">(physical body)</t>
    <t s="59">to which the revelation is drawn,</t>
    <t s="60">and by it being drawn into Havayah from the aspect of Anochi that is above Havayah, its revelation is drawn downward.</t>
    <t s="61">But the innovation in the diagram of the Name Havayah in the body is in the Name Havayah itself,</t>
    <t s="62">for the Name Havayah</t>
    <t s="63">(which is above the world)</t>
    <t s="64">and a body</t>
    <t s="65">(physical)</t>
    <t s="66">are two opposites.</t>
    <t s="67">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="68">in order that the Name Havayah should be depicted, as it were, in the form of a physical body,</t>
    <t s="69">this is not through the drawing down of a matter that is above it,</t>
    <t s="70">for the action that is done to something by a higher power is only that it be drawn down lower and the like,</t>
    <t s="71">but not a change in the thing itself.</t>
    <t s="72">And in order that the Name Havayah should be depicted, as it were, in the form of a physical body, it is through the drawing down and revelation of the inwardness and essentiality of the Name Havayah itself</t>
    <t s="73">(the filling of Havayah),</t>
    <t s="74">that</t>
    <t s="75">(also)</t>
    <t s="76">Havayah itself, in its inwardness,</t>
    <t s="77">is not defined by the definition of the spiritual, and it is within its capacity to also be in the form of a physical body.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that through the power given at Sinai, when a Jew studies Torah, the Holy One, blessed be He, reads and reviews opposite him, and similarly through mitzvos, and this power comes from the word "Anochi."</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And the maamar continues,</t>
    <t s="2">that the explanation of "And G-d spoke... saying" (vayidaber... leimor) is,</t>
    <t s="3">that at the Giving of the Torah, the power was given to every Jew that when he reads the Torah, the Holy One, blessed be He, reads and reviews opposite him.</t>
    <t s="4">And similarly regarding the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="5">that by a Jew performing a mitzvah, he causes and draws down that the Holy One, blessed be He, performs it.</t>
    <t s="6">And the power that every Jew has, that through his study of Torah the Holy One, blessed be He, will read and review opposite him, and through his fulfillment of mitzvos the Holy One, blessed be He, will fulfill the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="7">is through the word "Anochi Havayah your G-d" in the singular,</t>
    <t s="8">as explained in the maamar.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the concepts in the maamar about self-nullification and drawing down serve as introductions to the interpretation of "leimor," and all these interpretations are interconnected.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that the matters explained in the maamar as an introduction to the interpretation of "leimor" — that a person's Torah study causes the Holy One, blessed be He, to read and review opposite him — [namely] the self-nullification (bittul) of Israel through the Holy One, blessed be He, having joined His Name with them, and that the power that "Havayah will be your G-d" is from "Anochi" that is above Havayah, because the lower the drawing down is, it is because the root of the drawing down is from a more elevated source — they are analogous to the other interpretations of "leimor."</t>
    <t s="2">[This is not a separate source line but a continuation of the previous sentence; however, to match the source structure, it is rendered as a single translation unit for s="1".]</t>
    <t s="3">For the interpretation of "leimor,"</t>
    <t s="4">that the study of Torah is in a manner of "May my tongue answer Your word, like one who answers after the reader" — this is the emphasis of the matter of self-nullification,</t>
    <t s="5">and the interpretation that "And G-d spoke... saying" is the drawing down of the Ten Commandments into the Ten Utterances emphasizes the quality of drawing down below.</t>
    <t s="6">And that these two matters come in the maamar as an introduction to the interpretation that "leimor" is that through a person's Torah study he causes the Holy One, blessed be He, to read and review opposite him,</t>
    <t s="7">it is,</t>
    <t s="8">because all the interpretations</t>
    <t s="9">(the matters)</t>
    <t s="10">of "leimor" are related to each other.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
